product_summary: Apar Industries Ltd (apar.com) is a diversified Indian manufacturer with six business lines: (1) Speciality Oils — world's 3rd largest transformer oil maker, 350+ grades: transformer oil (POWEROIL), white oil, petroleum jelly, process oil; plants Rabale & Silvassa (India) + Hamriyah, Sharjah (UAE); (2) Conductors — world's largest aluminium/alloy conductor maker: ACSR, AACSR, AAAC, AAC, ACAR, ACSS, ACCC, INVAR/GAP HTLS, OPGW, copper CTC/PICC/EPICC, enamelled copper & aluminium strip/round wire, copper rods/wires/busbars/strips, railway catenary/contact wire, aluminium rods 1XXX–8XXX; (3) Cable Solutions — MV/HV XLPE up to 66 kV, LV XLPE/PVC control, aerial bunch, fire-performance FR/FRLSH/LSZH, railway signalling, elastomer/e-beam, ship & submarine, wind, solar (TUV/EN/UL), mining, welding, subsea, fibre optic/FTTH/ADSS, CAT5E/6 LAN, harnesses for locos/coaches/solar/EV; (4) Polymers — APARPRENE TPE/TPV/Modified TPU/TPR/TPE-E, XLPE compounds, ZHFR compounds; (5) Lubricants — 150+ BIS grades: hydraulic, gear, grease, thermic, turbine, refrigeration, compressor, metal-working fluids, automotive engine/gear oils; (6) Telecom Solutions and Speciality Automotive.
comment: HS 382499 ('other chemical products and preparations, n.e.s.') is a wrong/at best marginal classification for this company. It could at most cover a small slice of the speciality-oil/compound additives business, but the declared single code does not describe Apar's actual trade: transformer/insulating oils and process oils belong to 2710 19 (mineral oils) or 3403 (lubricating preparations), conductors to 7614/7326, copper products to 7407/7408, aluminium rods to 7601/7604/7605, cables and harnesses to 8544, polymer compounds to 3917/3920/4005. Per project rule 3 the HS mismatch is NOT a rejection ground: the company is retained and the code must be corrected to the actual product line(s) shipped. Industry label 'Нефтегаз и химия' is only partially right — Apar is primarily an electrical-conductor/cable and speciality-oils manufacturer (power T&D equipment + petrochemical blending), not an oil-and-gas or bulk-chemicals trader. No trader signs: own plants in Gujarat (Umbergaon, Khatalwada), Silvassa, Rabale, Odisha, plus UAE subsidiary; manufacturer role confirmed by own-site plant and product pages. Product lines entirely missing from the declaration: conductors (largest revenue line), cables, copper/aluminium semis, polymer compounds, lubricants. All product claims above are from the company's own website (apar.com/speciality-oils/, /conductors/, /cable-solutions/, /polymers/, /lubricants/) — i.e. 'заявлено, не подтверждено' by any customs line; no shipment or customs record was checked in this HS-only review, and no revenue/volume figures are asserted (null).
